title: Superintelligence: Science or Fiction? | Elon Musk & Other Great Minds
summary: A panel from the Beneficial AI 2017 conference moderated by Max Tegmark, with Elon Musk, Stuart Russell, Kurzweil, Hassabis, Harris, Bostrom, Chalmers and others. They discuss likely outcomes of human-level AGI and what outcomes are desirable.
why: HN mostly cites it for specific statements, such as Hassabis on AGI and safety buffers, rather than recommending it outright.
